answer: Cheap throwaway accounts become unprofitable because an attacker must fund every fake identity, and a raven watcher audits the vault ledger for duplicate device fingerprints, slashing bonds and forfeiting stake on collision. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks tokens in a shared vault, and the protocol kernel enforces a per-identity bond floor before any task reward is released. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
